title: Unit 1 · Учёба и работа
source: Unit 1: профили, глаголы + существительные, предметы и профессии

rules.title: Курсы и экзамены
summary: do / take a course in … — проходить курс
do / take an exam — сдавать экзамен (процесс)
pass an exam — сдать экзамен (успешно)
«Завтра сдаю» = I'm taking. «Сдал!» = I passed.

examples.target: I'm doing a course in English.
She is taking an important exam tomorrow.

rules.title: Диплом и квалификация
summary: do a degree in / study for a degree — учиться, получать диплом
have a degree in — диплом уже есть
То же с qualification: do / have a qualification in
О себе: I have a degree in… · My degree is in… · I studied … at university

examples.target: She is doing a degree in economics.
He has a degree in engineering.

rules.title: Работа
summary: work for a company / for myself — работать на компанию / на себя
work full-time / part-time — полный / неполный день
run your own company — своя компания (run – ran – run)
train as / work as a tour guide — учиться на гида / работать гидом

examples.target: She works for an international company.
I prefer to work for myself.

rules.title: Предмет → профессия
summary: Что изучаешь — без артикля: study law, study medicine
Кем работаешь — с a / an: work as a lawyer, work as an engineer
law → a lawyer · medicine → a doctor · science → a scientist · politics → a politician
economics → an economist · journalism → a journalist · architecture → an architect · engineering → an engineer

examples.target: She is studying medicine to become a doctor.
examples.native: Она изучает медицину, чтобы стать врачом.

examples.target: He works as an engineer in a large company.
examples.native: Он работает инженером в большой компании.

rules.title: Что делает профессия
summary: Профессия = он / она → глагол + s: A dentist helps… · A driver drives…
Вопрос: What does a dentist do? · What does she do?

examples.target: A dentist helps people with their teeth.
What does she do? — She's a receptionist.

rules.title: Рассказ о себе
summary: What do you do? — I'm a developer. / I work as a developer.
Where are you from? — I'm from… / I come from…
What do you like doing in your free time? — In my free time, I…
Why are you studying English? — Because I need it for my job.

examples.target: I come from Bilbao, but right now I'm living in Madrid.
examples.native: Я из Бильбао, но сейчас живу в Мадриде.

examples.target: I'm studying English because I need it for my job.
examples.native: Я учу английский, потому что он нужен мне для работы.

cards.answer: I'm doing a course in English.
alt: I'm taking a course in English.
cards.note: Сейчас, в процессе → I'm doing. do = take.

cards.answer: She's taking a course in management.
alt: She's doing a course in management.

cards.prompt: Я хочу пройти курс по Python.
cards.answer: I want to take a course in Python.
alt: I want to do a course in Python.

cards.answer: He's doing a course in programming.
alt: He's taking a course in programming.
I'm doing an exam tomorrow.
I have an exam tomorrow.
cards.note: «Сдаю» — результата ещё нет → take / do, не pass.

alt: I passed my exam!
Did you pass your exam?
I didn't pass it.

cards.prompt: На этой неделе мне сдавать три экзамена.
cards.answer: I have to do three exams this week.
alt: I have to take three exams this week.

cards.prompt: Мне скоро сдавать экзамен — надеюсь, сдам!
cards.answer: I have to take my exam soon — I hope I pass it!

cards.note: Сдаю (процесс) = take. pass = уже сдал успешно.
Курс, экзамен, диплом — do, не make.
Завтра сдаю — результата ещё нет → take.

cards.answer: She's doing a degree in economics.
alt: She's studying for a degree in economics.

cards.prompt: Моя жена учится в универе на экономиста.
cards.answer: My wife is studying for a degree in economics.
alt: My wife is doing a degree in economics.
My wife is studying economics.
cards.note: Проще: My wife is studying economics.

cards.answer: He has a degree in engineering.
cards.note: Диплом уже есть → have a degree in.

cards.answer: I have a degree in Computer Science.
My degree is in Computer Science.
I studied Computer Science at university.

cards.prompt: А у тебя диплом в какой области?

cards.answer: He has a qualification in IT.

cards.answer: She's studying for a qualification in finance.

cards.note: «Учусь на диплом» → study for, не on.

cards.prompt: I have a degree on engineering.
cards.answer: I have a degree in engineering.
